facts.note: race-research: the race's OWN official site (androslakesrace.com, now 'Coming Soon' live — found via Wayback Machine, archived 2025-02-12) has a 'Previous Editions' page listing all six editions to date by name and month, confirming 'First Edition - April 2019' matches this race exactly (123go.vn gave the exact day, 07/04/2019; this page confirms it's officially Edition 1, resolving the earlier doubt about whether it belongs to this series at all).
